app.name: Fazasanj
home.title: Choose a drive to scan
home.subtitle: Fazasanj shows where your space went, why it is there, and what you can safely remove.
start.fastHint: Reads the drive's file table directly. Takes seconds, but Windows will ask for admin permission.
start.fastUnavailable: Only works on NTFS drives. This one uses a different file system.
start.normalHint: Walks through every folder. Slower, but needs no admin permission.
start.readOnly: Scanning only reads. Nothing is changed or deleted.
progress.title: Scanning…
progress.fast: Fast scan is reading the file table.
progress.normal: Going through every folder. You can keep using your PC.
progress.waitingUac: Waiting for the admin permission window. If you say no, we switch to the normal scan.
scan.cancelled: The scan was stopped. You can start it again whenever you like.
summary.staleAfterCleanup: You cleaned up since this scan. Scan again to see the new numbers.
summary.grew: This grew by {delta} since the scan {when}. See what changed.
summary.shrank: This shrank by {delta} since the scan {when}. See what changed.
summary.denied: {count} folders could not be read, so they are not counted.
summary.uncounted: About {size} is in use but not in any file we could read (system areas, other users, or protected folders).
fallback.uac_refused: Fast scan needs admin permission, and it was not given. We used the normal scan instead. It is slower but gives the same result.
fallback.not_ntfs: Fast scan only works on NTFS drives, so we used the normal scan.
fallback.helper_failed: Fast scan could not start, so we used the normal scan. The result is the same.
fallback.timeout: Fast scan took too long to respond, so we used the normal scan.
story.driveHolds: {size} of this drive is in use.
story.canFree: You can safely free about {size} right now.
story.littleToFree: There is not much that is safe to remove without asking you first.
story.decide: Another {size} could go too, but you should decide.
story.freeHint: You will see the full list before anything happens.
story.needsDecisionHint: These can usually go, but only you know if you still need them.
story.nothingKnown: We did not recognize anything big here. Switch to Expert view to look around.
reason.whatHappens: What happens if I remove it?
list.name: Name
flags.cloud: Only in the cloud (takes no space here)
flags.hardlink: Same file as another path, counted once
detail.title: Details
detail.unknown: We don't have an explanation for this folder yet.
detail.aiOff: You can turn on AI explanations in Settings if you want a guess.
denied.explain: Windows did not let us read these folders. They usually belong to the system or another user. Their size is not counted, which is why the total can be lower than what Windows reports.
compare.explain: Runs the fast scan and the normal scan one after the other on this drive and lists folders where they disagree. It takes a while and asks for admin permission.
compare.same: Both scanners agree on every folder.
findings.explain: These checks look for things the knowledge base does not cover. They are educated guesses, so nothing here is ever marked safe.
findings.kind.stale: Files not used in a long time
findings.atimeOff: Windows is not recording when files are opened on this PC, so we can only go by when they were last changed.
cleanup.title: Review before cleaning up
cleanup.intro: {count} items, about {size}. Nothing happens until you press the button.
cleanup.blockedTitle: {count} items are protected and will be left alone
cleanup.permanentSafe: Delete the safe items for good instead (frees the space right away)
cleanup.restorePointHint: Some actions change Windows itself. A restore point lets you roll back. If it cannot be created, those actions are skipped.
cleanup.dryDone: Dry run finished. Nothing was changed. This is what would happen to about {size}.
cleanup.restoreFailed: The restore point could not be created, so system changes were skipped.
cleanup.restoreMade: A restore point was created first.
cleanup.skipped: {count} files were in use and skipped
cleanup.recycleReminder: Items in the Recycle Bin still take space on the same drive until you empty it.
warning.recycle_same_drive: Moving files to the Recycle Bin does not free space on the same drive until you empty the bin.
warning.needs_admin: Some actions need admin permission, so Windows will ask you.
warning.outside_sandbox: Development build: this path is outside the sandbox and will not be touched:
history.intro: Every cleanup is logged here, including what is still in the Recycle Bin.
growth.intro: Each scan keeps a small snapshot of folder sizes, so you can see what grew between two scans.
growth.empty: No snapshots yet. Scan a drive and come back after the next scan.
growth.needTwo: Scan this drive again later to compare.
settings.staleMonths: Call a file unused after this many months
settings.oldProjectMonths: Call a code project old after this many months
settings.trayHint: Closing the window keeps Fazasanj in the tray so it can warn you when a drive is almost full.
settings.weeklyHint: Once a week, tell me how much free space each drive gained or lost.
settings.lowSpace: Warn me when free space drops below (GB)
settings.sandboxHint: Development builds only delete inside this folder (for example the test drive filled by junk-gen).
settings.showOnboarding: Show the welcome screens next time
settings.resetHint: Removes settings, snapshots, cleanup history, cached AI answers and saved API keys. Your files are not touched.
settings.resetConfirm: This removes all Fazasanj data from this PC. Your own files stay where they are. Continue?
ai.title: AI explanations (optional)
ai.intro: For folders nothing else can explain, you can ask an AI provider with your own API key. The app works fully without it.
ai.enableHint: Off by default. Only runs when you press the button.
ai.point1: Only folder details are sent: sizes, dates, file types and the names of the biggest items. Never file contents.
ai.point2: Your Windows user name is always hidden. You can hide the other names too.
ai.point3: You see exactly what will be sent before the first request.
ai.point4: AI answers are never marked safe, and they can be wrong.
ai.warning: This is an AI guess and can be wrong. Check before you delete anything.
ai.maskHint: Names become folder_1, file_2 and so on. Answers get less precise.
ai.replaceKey: Paste a new key to replace the saved one
ai.keysLocal: Keys are stored in Windows Credential Manager, never in files or logs.
ai.previewTitle: This is what will be sent
ai.previewBody: Only this information leaves your PC. Your user name is replaced with <user>.
about.tagline: Find out where your disk space went, and what is safe to remove.
about.updateFailed: Could not check for updates. Maybe you are offline.
about.reportHint: If Fazasanj explained a folder wrong, please tell us. It helps everyone.
about.privacyText: Everything stays on your PC. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you turn on AI explanations and ask a question.
about.license: Open source under the MIT license.
onboarding.s1.title: Where did my space go?
onboarding.s1.body: Fazasanj scans a drive and tells you in plain words what is taking the space, and why.
onboarding.s2.title: Safe comes first
onboarding.s2.body: Every item gets a clear label: safe, probably safe, careful, or do not touch. You always see what will happen before anything is removed, and Windows system files are never deleted.
onboarding.s3.title: Fast when you want it
onboarding.s3.body: On NTFS drives the fast scan finishes in seconds. It asks for admin permission once per scan. If you say no, the normal scan does the same job a bit slower.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.blocked: This path is protected and can't be touched.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong inside the app. Please try again.
errors.rules_invalid: The built-in knowledge base could not be loaded.
errors.storage_error: Could not read or write the app's data.
errors.scan_root_not_found: That drive or folder was not found.
errors.scan_root_access_denied: Windows does not let us read that folder.
errors.scan_not_a_directory: That is a file, not a folder.
errors.fast_scan_unavailable: Fast scan is not available here, so the comparison can't run.
errors.scan_not_found: This scan is no longer open. Please scan again.
errors.node_not_found: That item is not part of this scan.
errors.plan_empty: There is nothing to clean up in this selection.
errors.plan_not_found: This cleanup plan expired. Please open it again.
errors.open_target_not_allowed: That setting is not on the list the app may open.
errors.invalid_model: That model name doesn't look right.
errors.ai_disabled: AI explanations are turned off in Settings.
errors.no_internet: No internet connection. Try again when you are online.
errors.timeout: The request took too long. Please try again.
errors.invalid_key: The provider rejected the API key. Check it and try again.
errors.rate_limited: The provider says too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.provider_error: The AI provider returned an error.
errors.invalid_response: The AI answer could not be understood. Try again or pick another model.
errors.no_key: No API key is saved for this provider.
errors.key_store_error: Windows Credential Manager could not be used.
errors.sandbox_not_configured: Development build: set a sandbox folder in Settings before deleting anything.
errors.outside_sandbox: Development build: this path is outside the sandbox.
errors.command_not_allowed: That command is not on the allowed list.
errors.vhdx_in_use: The virtual disk is in use. Shut down the virtual machine or WSL first.
errors.not_vhdx: That is not a virtual disk file.
errors.command_failed: The Windows tool reported an error.
errors.io_error: A file could not be read or removed.
errors.in_use: It is in use by another program.
errors.restore_point_failed: The restore point could not be created.
